data.title: Unfallkasse Musterland rejects your accident of 4 November 2024 as a work accident
data.summary: Unfallkasse Musterland decided that your accident on 4 November 2024 is not a covered commuting accident (Wegeunfall) under § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 SGB VII, because you interrupted your commute for a private errand and the fall happened in the supermarket. Your health insurer (Krankenkasse) will cover the treatment costs instead. You may object (Widerspruch) by the deadline shown in the app.
data.explanation: The accident insurance office (Unfallkasse) reviewed your case and decided your fall does not count as a work-related commuting accident because you had left your direct route for a private purpose (shopping). This means the accident insurance won't cover treatment costs, though your regular health insurance will. If you disagree with this assessment, you can file a written objection (Widerspruch) with the Unfallkasse; the app shows until when. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final and only your health insurance will handle the costs.

key_facts.label: Date of accident (Unfall vom)
key_facts.quote: Ihr Unfall vom 04.11.2024 – keine Anerkennung als Arbeitsunfall

key_facts.label: Legal basis for rejection
key_facts.quote: Der Unfall ist deshalb kein versicherter Wegeunfall im Sinne des § 8 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 SGB VII.

items.title: Decide whether to object to the rejection (Widerspruch)
items.action: If you disagree with the decision, send a written objection (Widerspruch) to Unfallkasse Musterland, or have it recorded in person (zur Niederschrift).
items.consequence: If you miss the deadline, the rejection becomes final and the accident will not be recognised as a covered work accident.
items.quote: Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Unfallkasse Musterland, Postfach 11 22, 35001 Musterbergen).

remedy.quote: Sind Sie mit diesem Bescheid nicht einverstanden, steht Ihnen der Widerspruch offen. Er muss uns innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift erreichen (Unfallkasse Musterland, Postfach 11 22, 35001 Musterbergen).
